observed_drafting_behavior: Two or more support sequences are deliberately represented on one reinforcement scheme instead of redrawing the full armature.
allowed_use: Treat the paired sequences as one authored schedule scope when the pairing is explicit on the source.
forbidden_use: Do not create a new pair solely because two beams look similar.
validation_requirement: Explicit paired sequences or stacked labels on the source plus topology match.
note: Confirms manual-drafting economy as an authored convention, not a generic analogy rule.

observed_drafting_behavior: The base drawing is reused and only differing dimensions are written in parentheses for the companion run.
allowed_use: Reuse common bar topology/count/diameter where the source explicitly binds the parenthesized variant; keep variant dimensions source-specific.
forbidden_use: Do not copy unparenthesized numerical lengths onto a companion run when a variant is not documented.
validation_requirement: Direct source note/parentheses and exact companion-sequence binding.
note: This is direct evidence that the designer minimized handwritten duplication.

observed_drafting_behavior: Corresponding node labels of parallel runs are stacked on the same graphic scheme.
allowed_use: Bind all explicitly stacked sequences to the same authored reinforcement scheme.
forbidden_use: Do not infer non-stacked parallel members.
validation_requirement: Readable stacked labels plus carpenteria topology match.
note: A compact notation for parallel/equivalent travate.

observed_drafting_behavior: The armature sheet explicitly states Armatura II° e III° impalcato; one schedule is intentionally reused on both levels.
allowed_use: Treat G2 and G3 as one authored source scope for the sequences actually represented by TAV-034A.
forbidden_use: Do not use G2/G3 identity alone to invent reinforcement for members absent from every source scheme.
validation_requirement: Same support topology and no contradictory section/source evidence.
note: Explains why the G2 and G3 direct-coverage pattern is identical.

observed_drafting_behavior: The designer's graphical unit is normally a continuous support sequence/travata, not an isolated finite-element span.
allowed_use: Project a group schedule onto its explicitly represented span chain while preserving support-station semantics.
forbidden_use: Do not interpret each finite-element beam ID as requiring a separate handwritten detail.
validation_requirement: Ordered support-sequence match and group-level reinforcement transcription.
note: Coverage auditing must distinguish drawing-unit coverage from per-member explicit text.

observed_drafting_behavior: The same 14 member positions are absent from direct group indexing on both G2 and G3.
allowed_use: Analyze the 14 positions as one shared drafting/source-scope problem and search for representative or symmetric schemes once, then validate on both levels.
forbidden_use: Do not transfer a numeric armature from one level to the other merely because both are gaps.
validation_requirement: For each candidate: same support role, section from M1-S/storey ledger, source-authored equivalence rule and no contradiction.
note: The repeated omission pattern is structured, not random, but is not itself reinforcement evidence.

source_evidence: Derived from M1A-BDL-001..007 and user-qualified historical drafting practice
observed_drafting_behavior: Symmetry is admissible only when reconstructed from the designer's own repeated notation conventions and corroborated by topology/section evidence.
allowed_use: Classify explicit shorthand as DOC; classify uniquely reconstructed authored equivalence as INF_STRONG_DRAFTING_RULE; retain ambiguous cases ND.
forbidden_use: No adjacency-only, visual-similarity-only or section-only armature copying.
validation_requirement: At least two independent supports among source notation, topology, section, span geometry, cross-storey authored scope; zero contradictions.
note: Replaces the overly broad prohibition on all symmetry-based analysis without weakening provenance discipline.
